requirements.requirement: Realistic small examples and combined edit/measurement workflows
requirements.verified: 72 passed: six examples × six selected-atom orders × two widths; four cycles per case varying pointer steps, measured/unmeasured atom edits, cell growth/shrink, sidebar resizing/collapse, shifting, addition, mode switching, display rebuilds, periodic copies, constraints and deletion/history.

requirements.requirement: Inspect visible rendering, not numerical state alone
requirements.verified: Personally inspected rendered states across all six examples, all six measurement orders and both widths, including close water, small angles, crowded bonds, fixed overlays and history. Final inspection found no new confirmed fault.

requirements.requirement: Measurements track actual selected atoms during editing and history
requirements.verified: Campaign asserts three exact selected indices, actual Cartesian distances and angle, logical caption anchors, physical marker positions and displayed sidebar values after every transition; undo/redo verifies coordinates, lattice, atom identities and selective dynamics.

requirements.requirement: Bond rendering follows edited geometry without stale segments
requirements.verified: Rendered segment endpoints and ghost classifications equal a fresh display rebuild after each cycle; screenshots inspected for stale visible bonds.

requirements.requirement: Reproduce confirmed faults and fix root causes through ordinary interactions
requirements.verified: Seven confirmed fixes implemented and saved; focused regressions and before/after evidence retained.

requirements.requirement: Run relevant regressions on the final source
requirements.verified: 154 unit tests,179 full browser regressions,72 sustained chains passed; no skips, failures or flaky results. Product and campaign source hashes unchanged at completion.

requirements.requirement: Save changes locally without pushing or adding buttons
requirements.verified: Product fixes and visual evidence saved in local commits on codex/structure-and-usability-fixes; no push performed and no new buttons added. Original user browser tab left untouched.

knownLimits: Finite tested workflows cannot prove absence of every possible bug. Some history screenshots retain a user-positioned camera with atoms outside the viewport; numeric identities and geometry were verified, and this was not treated as a stale-geometry fault.
